guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：矽像素粒子追蹤器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Silicon-pixel particle trackers
guides.concept: 以 CMS 與 ALICE 的像素追蹤器為參照，從最小游離粒子在 285 µm 矽中釋放約兩萬兩千個電子出發，把空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、混合式與 MAPS 架構、輻射損傷、位置解析度、物質量、觸發緩衝與軌跡式對準串成一份可驗收、可交接的追蹤器工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using the CMS and ALICE pixel trackers as references, start from the roughly 22,000 electrons a minimum-ionising particle frees in 285 µm of silicon, then connect depletion and Lorentz drift, hybrid versus MAPS architectures, radiation damage, spatial resolution, material budget, trigger buffering and track-based alignment into an acceptable, transferable tracker engineering record.
procedure: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。少數高能 δ 電子會一次帶走大量能量，使能損分佈成為右尾很長的 Landau 分佈，最可能值只有平均值的約七成，因此門檻與信噪比必須用最可能值而非平均值設計。像素追蹤器的任務，就是在 LHC 25 ns 的束團間隔內把這數千到兩萬多個電子收集進讀出電路，並判斷它是否越過門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

矽感測器是一個大面積的反向偏壓 p–n 二極體，只有空乏區內產生的電荷會在電場中漂移並在讀出電極感應出訊號，未空乏區的電荷只能慢慢擴散甚至被複合，所以感測器必須全空乏或至少讓集電側空乏。空乏深度隨偏壓的平方根增加，全空乏電壓與有效摻雜濃度及厚度平方成正比。在 CMS 3.8 T 螺線管磁場中，漂移的電子受 Lorentz 力偏轉，使電荷橫向散到相鄰像素；工程上反而利用這個偏轉做電荷分享內插。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反向偏壓空乏區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

混合式像素把高阻值感測器與 CMOS 讀出晶片分開製造，再以每像素一顆的焊錫或銦凸塊倒裝接合，因此感測器可採 n-in-n 或 n-in-p 的抗輻射設計，讀出晶片可用先進製程；CMS Phase-1 像素為 100×150 µm²、285 µm 厚，每顆讀出晶片 52×80 像素。單體式主動像素感測器（MAPS）把電荷收集層與前端電路做在同一片晶圓上，例如 ALICE ITS2 的 ALPIDE 以 180 nm CMOS 影像感測製程製作約 29×27 µm² 的像素並薄化到 50 µm，省去凸塊與第二層矽；代價是電荷主要來自數十微米的磊晶層，抗輻射能力與時間解析度不如混合式。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

強子與高能粒子在矽晶格中造成位移損傷，以 1 MeV 中子等效通量 Φ_eq 計量，產生能隙中間的缺陷能階，帶來三種後果：漏電流依 ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V 線性增加；有效摻雜改變，使 n 型基體發生型別反轉並讓空乏電壓持續上升；以及載子被缺陷捕獲使收集電荷下降。漏電流依 T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) 強烈依賴溫度，約每降 7 K 減半，所以內層像素必須冷到攝氏零下十到二十度；漏電流發熱又會加熱感測器，冷卻不足就會形成熱失控。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12；當電荷因 Lorentz 偏移、斜入射或擴散分到兩個像素時，用類比電荷資訊（ADC 或 ToT）做重心或 η 修正內插，解析度可比二元讀出好約三倍。良好的電荷分享需要低門檻與低雜訊，否則邊緣像素的小訊號會被切掉，叢集退化成單像素。驗證解析度需要比待測元件更準的參考，也就是由數層薄 MAPS 組成的測試束望遠鏡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

追蹤器每一層的矽、讀出晶片、冷卻管、碳纖維支撐與電纜都會讓粒子發生多重庫侖散射，散射角寬度依 Highland 公式與 √(x/X₀) 成正比、與動量成反比。低動量粒子的撞擊參數與頂點解析度通常由物質量而非像素解析度決定，所以內層設計的競賽是降低 X/X₀ 並縮小第一層半徑；只有在高動量時才回到幾何項，由命中解析度與層間槓桿臂決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「每層物質量與束管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。觸發式讀出必須把每個命中保留到第一級觸發決定到來（CMS 約 4 µs），讀出晶片以雙欄為單位暫存時間戳記與電荷，緩衝滿了新命中就遺失；被觸發的事件再經串列鏈路送出，鏈路頻寬決定可承受的觸發率。因此系統效率損失不只來自感測器，也來自數位架構的死時間與緩衝溢位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。某些整體變形如扭轉、伸縮與弓形，讓所有軌跡仍然擬合良好卻系統性地偏移動量，稱為弱模態，只能靠宇宙射線、束暈軌跡或 Z→μμ 質量約束打破。試運轉交接必須包含幾何版本、Lorentz 角、門檻與遮罩像素表以及對準驗證圖。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. A few energetic delta electrons occasionally carry away a large share of the energy, so the loss follows a Landau distribution with a long upper tail whose most probable value is only about 70% of the mean; thresholds and signal-to-noise must therefore be designed on the most probable value, not the mean. The pixel tracker's job is to collect these several thousand to twenty-odd thousand electrons into the readout circuit within the 25 ns LHC bunch spacing and decide whether they cross threshold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A silicon sensor is a large-area reverse-biased p–n diode: only charge generated inside the depleted region drifts in the field and induces a signal on the readout electrode, whereas charge in undepleted silicon diffuses slowly or recombines, so the sensor must be fully depleted or at least depleted on the collecting side. Depletion depth grows with the square root of bias, and the full-depletion voltage scales with effective doping and the square of thickness. In the 3.8 T CMS solenoid field the drifting electrons are deflected by the Lorentz force and spread charge sideways into neighbouring pixels, an effect engineers exploit for charge-sharing interpolation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reverse-biased depletion region”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hybrid pixels fabricate a high-resistivity sensor and a CMOS readout chip separately and flip-chip join them with one solder or indium bump per pixel, so the sensor can use radiation-hard n-in-n or n-in-p designs while the readout chip uses an advanced process; CMS Phase-1 pixels are 100×150 µm², 285 µm thick, with 52×80 pixels per readout chip. Monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) put the charge-collecting layer and front-end circuit in the same wafer; ALICE ITS2's ALPIDE uses a 180 nm CMOS imaging process with pixels of about 29×27 µm² thinned to 50 µm, eliminating bumps and a second silicon layer, at the cost of collecting charge mainly from an epitaxial layer tens of micrometres thick and having lower radiation tolerance and timing performance than hybrids. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hadrons and energetic particles cause displacement damage in the silicon lattice, quantified by the 1 MeV neutron-equivalent fluence Φ_eq, creating mid-gap defect levels with three consequences: leakage current rises linearly as ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V; effective doping changes, inverting n-type bulk and steadily raising the depletion voltage; and carriers are trapped, reducing collected charge. Leakage follows T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) and roughly halves for every 7 K of cooling, so inner pixel layers must run at −10 to −20 °C; because the leakage current itself heats the sensor, insufficient cooling leads to thermal runaway. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. Good sharing requires low threshold and low noise, otherwise the small signal in the edge pixel is cut and the cluster collapses to a single pixel. Verifying resolution needs a reference more precise than the device under test, which is a beam telescope built from several thin MAPS planes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum. For low-momentum particles the impact-parameter and vertex resolution is usually set by material rather than by pixel resolution, so inner-layer design becomes a contest to cut X/X₀ and shrink the first-layer radius; only at high momentum does the geometric term, set by hit resolution and the lever arm between layers, dominate again. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Per-layer material and beam pipe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. Triggered readout must hold every hit until the first-level trigger decision arrives, about 4 µs at CMS; the readout chip buffers timestamps and charge per double column and loses new hits once the buffer is full, and triggered events then leave over serial links whose bandwidth sets the sustainable trigger rate. System inefficiency therefore comes not only from the sensor but also from dead time and buffer overflow in the digital architecture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Double-column buffers and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. Certain global deformations such as twist, telescope and bowing leave every track well fitted yet bias momentum systematically; these weak modes are broken only with cosmic rays, beam-halo tracks or Z→μμ mass constraints. The commissioning handoff must include the geometry version, Lorentz angle, thresholds and masked-pixel tables, and alignment validation plots. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Track residuals and alignment parameters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。
照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。
pitfallsEn: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops.

After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset.

related.title: 時間投影室偵測器
related.transfer: 可遷移「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」與「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；時間投影室偵測器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" and "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Time-projection-chamber detectors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準；時間投影室偵測器則以氣體漂移、GEM 增益、空間電荷校正與連續讀出的 TPC 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment; Time-projection-chamber detectors centres on gas drift, GEM gain, space-charge calibration and continuous readout for TPC engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」與「中央電極與漂移體積」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到時間投影室偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” and “Central electrode and drift volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Time-projection-chamber detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
related.transfer: 可遷移「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」與「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；低雜訊偵測器讀出的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" and "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Low-noise detector readout must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準；低雜訊偵測器讀出則以電荷靈敏前端的 ENC、整形時間與系統雜訊預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment; Low-noise detector readout centres on ENC, shaping time and system noise budgets for charge-sensitive front ends, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」與「感測器電荷與回授電容」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到低雜訊偵測器讀出，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” and “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Low-noise detector readout, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
history.text: 混合式像素偵測器在 1990 年代由 CERN 的 RD19 等研發計畫推動，先在固定靶與 LEP 實驗中運轉，2008 年起 ATLAS 與 CMS 以數千萬像素的混合式系統成為 LHC 的最內層追蹤器，CMS 的像素系統由 PSI 等機構主導建造，並於 2017 年升級為四層的 Phase-1 偵測器。單體式 MAPS 源自可見光 CMOS 影像感測器，2014 年在 RHIC 的 STAR 首次用於對撞機頂點偵測器，2022 年 ALICE ITS2 以約 125 億像素、10 m² 的 ALPIDE 投入運轉。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Hybrid pixel detectors were developed in the 1990s by CERN research programmes such as RD19 and first operated in fixed-target and LEP experiments; from 2008 ATLAS and CMS ran hybrid systems with tens of millions of pixels as the LHC's innermost trackers, the CMS pixel system being built under the lead of PSI and partners and upgraded to the four-layer Phase-1 detector in 2017. Monolithic MAPS grew out of visible-light CMOS image sensors, served first in a collider vertex detector at STAR at RHIC in 2014, and in 2022 ALICE ITS2 began operation with about 12.5 billion ALPIDE pixels over 10 m². This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」到「軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" through "Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
